Key facts & formulas to remember

  • CTET Paper II Mathematics & Science has 60 questions; the maths portion rewards speed and accuracy.

  • Skipping the review step after a mock test.
  • Ignoring time management until the exam day.

quiz.title: CTET Paper 2 Maths Practice Quiz
quiz.intro: Ten CTET Paper II–pattern questions. Pick an answer for each, then press Check my score.

questions.q: What is the difference between the place value and the face value of the digit 7 in the number 7,85,632?
Which of the following is the smallest whole number?
questions.explanation: Whole numbers start from 0 and include all natural numbers. Hence, 0 is the smallest whole number.

questions.q: What is the sum of the predecessor of -15 and the successor of -8?
questions.explanation: The predecessor of -15 is -15 - 1 = -16. The successor of -8 is -8 + 1 = -7. Their sum is (-16) + (-7) = -23.
We know that 2^(-1) = 1/2 and 3^(-1) = 1/3. Therefore, 2^(-1) + 3^(-1) = 1/2 + 1/3 = (3+2)/6 = 5/6. Taking the inverse of this sum, we get (5/6)^(-1) = 6/5.

questions.q: If A : B = 3 : 4 and B : C = 8 : 9, then A : C is equal to:
questions.explanation: Given A : B = 3 : 4 and B : C = 8 : 9. To find A : C, we can multiply the two ratios: (A / B) × (B / C) = (3 / 4) × (8 / 9) = 24 / 36 = 2 / 3. Therefore, A : C = 2 : 3.

questions.q: An angle whose measure is greater than that of a right angle and less than a straight angle is called a:
questions.explanation: An angle greater than 90 degrees (right angle) and less than 180 degrees (straight angle) is defined as an obtuse angle.

questions.q: A shape has reflection symmetry if it can be divided into two identical halves by a line. Which of the following shapes does NOT have reflection symmetry?
questions.explanation: A general parallelogram (one that is not a rectangle or a rhombus) cannot be folded along any line so that the two halves match — it has no reflection symmetry at all. The equilateral triangle, rectangle, and circle all have at least one line of symmetry.

questions.q: Which of the following instruments is most appropriate to draw a line segment of a given definite length accurately?
questions.explanation: To draw a line segment of a given definite length accurately, a ruler (to measure the length) and a compass (to mark off the exact radius/length) are used together.

questions.q: If the side of a regular hexagon is doubled, how many times does its perimeter become?
questions.explanation: The perimeter of a regular hexagon with side length s is given by P = 6s. If the side is doubled to 2s, the new perimeter is P' = 6(2s) = 2(6s) = 2P. Thus, the perimeter becomes 2 times the original.

questions.q: The mean of the first five prime numbers is:
questions.explanation: The first five prime numbers are 2, 3, 5, 7, and 11. Their sum = 2 + 3 + 5 + 7 + 11 = 28. The mean = 28 / 5 = 5.6.
